newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes cuts back on service.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes cuts back on service.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd, which voluntarily suspended flights on May 16, said on Monday that it will not resume service at eight cities where it had previously operated as United Express.

Those cities are Aberdeen and Brookings, S.D.; Escanaba, Mich.; Decatur, Mount Vernon and Sterling, Ill.; Duluth, Minn.; and Omaha, Neb. The company said it decided not to reinstate service at these communities due to economics.
The carrier continues to reinstate flights at other communities in the Midwest and at present is offering service to seventeen airports with ten Beechcraft 1900D aircraft.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
